Little Patterns round 4: built

The Nook frame, the Shapes game, Feelings around Nook and the faster speech are built and committed on this PC, by Opus 5.5 in six phases with Fable reviewing between them. Nothing is deployed or pushed. The screens below are the real build, photographed by the test harness.

Built locally. Waiting for your device test and two answers.
198tests passing (128 before)
6screen sizes checked, 65 states each
323voice clips, all trimmed
5pspent on new recordings

What to do next

  1. Test it on the S24 and the iPadServe it from this PC over Wi-Fi and follow the checklist in DEVICE-TEST.md. Nothing is called finished before this. The sheet lists the exact Safari 16 things to try, including Nook's texture bench.
  2. Speech: joined words or whole sentences?On the listening page, the same line is 7.0 s today, 6.0 s joined and 3.7 s as one recording. If the whole sentence is what you want, it is about 110 more clips (one day at the cap) for the most-played Add, Take away and Count lines. Also say whether “more” still sounds breathy.
  3. Nook's grainThe texture bench on the iPad shows Nook with and without paper grain and measures it. Say which you prefer; grain stays off until then.
  4. Three armsProud, frustrated and worried are the nearest honest poses the rig can reach. Look at the bodies strip below and say if any needs another go.
  5. DeployOnly when you say so. The command exists and has not been run.

To serve it to the phone and the iPad, in a terminal in the repo:

node tools/serve-fireworks.cjs 8787

Then open the printed Wi-Fi address plus /little-patterns/ on each device. The listening page: python -m http.server 8790 --directory docs/little-patterns-round-4/build/phase-5/listen, then open port 8790. The full checklist is docs/little-patterns-round-4/build/DEVICE-TEST.md.

The six phases

  1. Nook0beec8eTraced from the original picture into a vector rig: rest, hello and ten feelings. Breath, blinks and expression changes behind a blink. Untextured until the iPad bench decides.
  2. Frame and shelf78f1b94One frame for every game, the shelf with eight tiles, Grown-ups behind a two-second hold, a home-screen manifest. Count, Add, Words and Patterns moved in. All 63 old interface tests rewritten; a six-size layout check added.
  3. Shapesa08d24eSides (tap each side, counted once, numbered in tap order) and Name, two levels, 33 example shapes. Add and Take away now offer answers near the right one.
  4. Feelings0fbf2bfNook feels… with the full-screen performance and the breath back to calm; Which feeling?; Friends unchanged; Me, private. Small pay-offs: Nook munches in Take away, holds the shape, wears the beads.
  5. Voiceeacd63576 new clips for about 5p; every clip trimmed of its dead air; joined lines play as one piece; a listening page for your decision.
  6. Checks71fa007Final fixes, 198 tests, the layout check at six sizes, 138 screenshots, the device-test sheet.

Full detail: docs/little-patterns-round-4/build/BUILD-REPORT.md and the six phase reports beside it. Left as judgement calls, listed there: a tap on resting Nook says "Nook feels happy."; Help in Sides counts one side per press; sentence breaks keep 300 ms.
